item.title: Using Jupyter to learn Fortran
item.description: Having heard people talk about the performance improvements that Fortran gives over R or Python, I got curious - how hard is it to learn? Turns out that more recent standards of Fortran, such as Fortran 95, are pretty easy to pick up, so I started working my way through this excellent tutorial. However, while I started out by writing separate scripts, I got really annoyed not being able to take notes alongside my scripts or keep related scripts together in the same document. As such, I started looking at my options for running my Fortran scripts within a Jupyter notebook.
